name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A packaged set of instructions that teach your AI coding assistant to work the way an experienced engineer would: asking clarifying questions first, writing less bloated code, and following a disciplined process.
buyer: A dev-tools educator or coding bootcamp/newsletter who wants ready-made 'how to work with AI' curriculum to resell or bundle with paid training.
business_use_cases: An engineering manager installs it team-wide to make every developer's AI assistant behave more consistently, cutting review time on AI-generated code.
A paid newsletter author (as the creator already does) uses the free repo to funnel readers into a subscription for deeper, kept-current tips.
A consultancy adapts the skill set as a branded 'AI engineering standards' package it installs for client engineering teams.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid newsletter/course teaching how to write and tune these skills, with the open repo as the funnel.
Offer a 'install and customize our AI engineering skills for your team' consulting package.

steal_this: Clone the repo, pick your three favorite skills, and offer a half-day workshop teaching a dev team how to install and adapt them for their own stack.
